english.note: 會考放榜 means the public exam results come out.

exampleSentences.english: Yes, yes. I’m listening to the news. The exam results came out last week, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 有，有。聽新聞喇，喀。上個禮拜會考放榜吖嗎。

exampleSentences.traditional: 佢放榜嘅時候，噉我同學呢打電話呢返來我實驗室喎。
